description: Mixed engagement — alternating disclosure and deflection. Tests state-dependent variance: directives/emotions should vary with the swings, not sit flat.

turns.message: Hey Aria. Weird day. Good and bad all at once.
The good part: I got asked to lead the new project at work!
But honestly I'm terrified I'm not good enough for it.
Ugh, forget I said that. Tell me something fun instead.
Ha, okay that did make me smile.
It's just... the last person who led a project like this got let go when it failed.
Do you ever get tired of me dumping stuff on you and then taking it back?
Okay, real talk: I want this promotion so badly it scares me.
Thanks. That actually helps. You're good at this, you know.
I'm going to say yes to the project tomorrow morning.
Wish me luck. And... thanks for not letting me deflect forever.
